The value of this field is printed at the end of the script

activeBlades.description: Required. Indicates which blades to Activate
activeBlades.x-deprecatedMessage: Blades are created using the policy assignment metadata instead

vendor.description:
Required. Default is azure
Allowed values: azure, azuregov, azurechina

useCloudGuardManagedApp.description:
Specifies whether to use the Check Point application to connect the subscriptions to CloudGuard
Required

isAutoOnboarding.description:
Optional. Default is true
Declares if the onboarding pipeline automatically onboards newly discovered subscriptions after the initial onboarding.

Dome9.BL.Std.Services.OrganizationalUnit.description: The guids of the source organizational unit to detach from and the target organizational unit to attach to. Use null for root organizational unit.
